description:
Implement the canonical generated-desktop update behavior so apps ship with a sensible default instead of each release inventing its own UX.

This should cover:
- startup update checks by default for production-ready desktop builds
- background download behavior for available updates
- a low-friction customer-visible prompt when an update is ready to apply
- per-app override hooks for future manual-only or disabled policies
- documentation and configuration seams so LPBS-backed updates and scenario-to-desktop defaults stay aligned

Goal: generated apps default to a non-invasive auto-update flow that is consistent, configurable, and ready to test end to end.
name: scenario-to-desktop-canonical-update-policy
title: Set The Canonical Desktop Update Policy And Overrides
